findings.title: queue.ShutDown requires Python 3.13
findings.body: `queue.ShutDown` and `Queue.shutdown()` exist only in Python 3.13+. If the runtime is older, the `except queue.ShutDown` clauses raise AttributeError at the point the exception is evaluated. `q.shutdown(...)` also raises AttributeError, which is swallowed with a logged error, so workers blocked in `get()` never wake and shutdown hangs.
